backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining session management, image upload, and transformation workflow with types for emotions, cartoon styles, and transformation results stored in a Map-based session store.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (image upload, emotion/style selectors, transformation workflow, results display) to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including styling, hooks for queries/uploads/transformations, and UI components for the complete transformation workflow.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm color palette using OKLCH color system for both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Emotion Cartoonify application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders the TransformationPage as the main application view.
frontend/src/components/CartoonStyleSele: UI component for selecting cartoon styles (Ghibli/anime, comic book, pixel art, watercolor, pop art) with featured Ghibli example image and style descriptions.
frontend/src/components/DownloadButton.t: Button component that retrieves image bytes from ImageData blob and triggers browser download with timestamped filename.
UI component displaying five emotion options (happy, sad, surprised, angry, neutral) with icon images in a grid layout for single selection.
frontend/src/components/ImageUpload.tsx: Drag-and-drop image upload component with file validation (JPEG/PNG/WebP, 10MB), preview display, and reset functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component providing header with app branding, background decoration, main content area, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/LoadingIndicator: Loading indicator component that displays animated spinner and progress messages for different transformation states (uploading, processing-emotion, processing-style) with optional upload progress bar.
frontend/src/components/TransformationRe: Results display component showing three-column grid with original, emotion-transformed, and cartoon-transformed images, plus download button for final result.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useImageUpload.ts: Hook managing image file upload with validation (type, size), preview generation, progress tracking, and conversion to ExternalBlob format.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks wrapping backend actor methods for session management, image upload, transformation requests, and result saving with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useTransformation.ts: Orchestrates the complete transformation workflow (upload, emotion processing, cartoon styling) with state management, error handling, and mock transformation simulation for demo purposes.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm sunset color palette for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors in OKLCH format.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/TransformationPage.ts: Main transformation page component that orchestrates the image upload, emotion selection, cartoon style selection, and displays transformation results with loading states and reset functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), OKLCH color system, custom animations (accordion, fade-in, pulse-glow), and warm shadow effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining the image transformation application with features for uploading photos, selecting emotions and cartoon styles, processing transformations, and displaying results with required image assets listed.
